description.narrative: Arcelik A.S. (Arcelik or the Company) is a major Turkish white goods manufacturer with global operations. Arcelik would like to proceed with an investment program in Turkiye which is comprised of (i) expenditures linked to improving earthquake resilience of Arceliks six production facilities (ii) financing of two newly built solar power plants for captive use, (iii) research and development expenditures (the Project). The Project is planned to be funded with an IFC senior unsecured A Loan package of up to EUR200 million (the IFC Loan).

IFC expects the Projects development outcomes to include (i) environmental / climate effects: reduction of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions; and (ii) economywide effects: foreign exchange generation, employment and domestic value addition. The anticipated market-level outcome is the enhancement of Turkish home appliances sectors sustainability by supporting a leading company in issuing its first sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL) with targets set by the Science-Based Target initiative (SBTi).
